scope: Completed Stage A-C science, controls, required momentum diagnostics, validation evidence and final accounting; plus completed independently tuned BMMC scaling and SNARE/BMMC cross-dataset extensions.
raw_run_archives: Original tuning/final/pilot and companion archives are preserved separately under local ruche_results and their frozen Ruche experiment roots. This review inventory excludes raw data and coupling NPZs.
